# 004 — Locally owned shadcn components behind one barrel

**Decision.** UI primitives are generated by the shadcn CLI in RTL mode into `src/components/ui/` and
committed. App code imports only from `@/components/UiComponents` (the barrel) or `@/components/ui/*`.
Importing `@radix-ui/*`, `sonner`, `react-day-picker` or `input-otp` anywhere else is a lint error.

**Why.** The previous vendor UI package disappeared from the registry and broke fresh installs; owning
the source removes that risk and lets the RTL, direction and locale fixes live in the components
themselves. A single import surface means a component can be swapped or wrapped once without touching
callers, and it is the one place where `DirectionProvider`, logical `side` props and icon flipping are
guaranteed.

**Consequences.** Updating a component is `npx shadcn@latest add <name>` plus re-applying any local
changes; the `shadcn` skill documents this. `/components` is the visual regression surface for both
directions and is kept in the app behind login.
